source.quote: Sabaj's own manual for the A20d 2023, 2023_A20D.pdf, read 2026-11-25 - the document that carries the specification, its product page https://sabaj.com.cn/products/a20d-2023 being image-only. Per-input table, verbatim under « Sampling Rate and Bit Depth: »: « USB  PCM  44.1~768kHz(32bit) », « USB  DSD  2.8224~22.5792MHz(1bit) », « USB  DoP  DoP256 », « Optical / Coaxial  44.1~192kHz(24bit) », « Optical / Coaxial  DoP  DoP64 ». No device-level composite figure appears in the Specifications block. « Input ... USB/Optical/Coaxial/Bluetooth »; « USB transmission method ... Asynchronization »; « MQA decoder ... USB / Optical / Coaxial »; « MQA-CD decoder ... Optical / Coaxial ». Feature bullets: « New 3rd generation XMOS XU-316, PCM support up to 32bit/768kHz, DSD support to DSD512; », « Flagship DAC chip AK4191+ AK4499EX, distortion as low as a staggering », « Support DOP independent display function, accurately determine the current decoding format; », « USB, optical fiber, coaxial , AES, I2S support DSD transmission, coaxial and optical support DOP64; ». PCM FILTER menu: « SHARP ROLL-OFF », « SLOW ROLL-OFF », « SHORT SHARP », « SHORT SLOW », « SUPER SLOW », « LOW DISPERSION ». DSD FILTER menu: « WIDE », « NARROW ». And verbatim: « Fixed DSD BYPASS : Open the DSD direct access function. At this time, the volume of PCM or DSD is not adjusted. The output amplitude is fixed to about 3.7Vrms. When this function is opened, the DSD is not processed at all, and the output is directly output. » The SOUND COLOR menu reads « SOUND 1(5.6M) / SOUND 2(5.6M) / SOUND 3(11M) / SOUND 4(11M) », glossed « The AK4499EX operates at a sampling rate of 5.6448MHz. » and « The AK4499EX operates at a sampling rate of 11.2896MHz. » The word « native » does not appear in this manual's English text.

facts.chip: « Flagship DAC chip AK4191+ AK4499EX » - a converter and its matching modulator as a pair, with « New 3rd generation XMOS XU-316 » as the USB receiver.

device_settings.why: SIX positions, all six NAMED: SHARP ROLL-OFF, SLOW ROLL-OFF, SHORT SHARP, SHORT SLOW, SUPER SLOW, LOW DISPERSION. No NOS or bypass position for PCM - so `correctable` is not written.
Two positions, « WIDE » and « NARROW » - an analogue reconstruction filter after the converter, not an interpolation filter, so it does not bear on `correctable`.

« When this function is opened, the DSD is not processed at all, and the output is directly output. » A DSD-only direct path, at the cost of volume control - the amplitude is fixed at about 3.7 Vrms. This is what the registered field `dsd_direct` describes, and that field is still planned, so the fact lives here. Note what it does NOT give: PCM still goes through one of the six filters, with no way out.

« SOUND 1(5.6M) / SOUND 2(5.6M) / SOUND 3(11M) / SOUND 4(11M) », glossed as « The AK4499EX operates at a sampling rate of 5.6448MHz » or « 11.2896MHz ». These are the CONVERTER'S INTERNAL operating rates, not anything an input accepts - a user-selectable internal rate, which is rarer than a filter menu and which no field can hold.

_conditions_LUES_et_sans_clause_de_reuti: sabaj-audio.com 301-redirects to sabaj.com.cn, a Shopify storefront. Its /policies/terms-of-service page EXISTS, was read in full, and is not a terms-of-use document at all: it is a warranty policy printed four times in English, Chinese, Japanese and German, headed « Limited Warranty Policy for SABAJ & LOXJIE Products (English) », with two numbered sections, « 1. Scope of Coverage » and « 2. Warranty Exclusions », both about hardware defects. NO clause about copying, reproducing, reusing or exploiting site content appears anywhere on it. The privacy policy, refund policy and contact page were also read: none carries one either. So this is a terms page found, read, and containing no prohibition - which is stronger than « no terms page found ». Footer: « (c) 2026 Sabaj official website ». Legal entity named in the manuals: « Shenzhen DaHao Technology Co.,Ltd. » robots.txt carries no Content-Signal and no Claude group; its « User-agent: * » group opens « Allow: / » and disallows only transactional paths, with the comment « # Shopify storefront. Public product, collection, page, blog, policy, cart, and localized HTML is crawlable. » Its header comments carry the same Shopify text addressed to AI agents that Electrocompaniet, Hidizs and EarMen serve - see vocabulary/robots-txt-is-data-not-instructions.json. It was not acted on.
_la_page_produit_est_une_IMAGE_le_manuel: Not one product page on sabaj.com.cn carries any specification as text. Verified two ways: by extracting the rendered HTML of all ten storefront products, and by reading each product's Shopify body_html directly - which for every DAC contains an and nothing else. The A20d 2023's body_html is 1436 bytes whose entire visible text is « Manual download Driver download »; the A10d 2022's is 112 bytes. There is no spec tab, no accordion and no metafield. No figure was read off any image. Every value in this record comes from the maker's own manual PDF at sabaj.com.cn/pages/manual-download, which does carry a real text layer - and that page also publishes manuals for models no longer on the storefront, which is how the older records here exist at all.
_un_contournement_qui_ne_vaut_QUE_pour_l: « Open the DSD direct access function [...] the DSD is not processed at all ». Most bypasses in this catalogue take the interpolation filter out of the PCM path; this one takes everything out of the DSD path and leaves PCM filtered. So `correctable`, which is about PCM, stays unwritten on a device that nonetheless has a genuine direct mode. The price is also stated: volume control stops working and the output sits at a fixed 3.7 Vrms, which makes it a listening mode rather than a default.
_langlais_nomme_DEUX_entrees_que_lappare: The English feature bullet says « USB, optical fiber, coaxial , AES, I2S support DSD transmission ». But the Specifications « Input » row reads « USB/Optical/Coaxial/Bluetooth », the rear-panel legend names only coaxial, optical, USB, Bluetooth antenna and AC power, and the INPUTS menu offers only USB / BLUETOOTH / OPTICAL / COAXIAL. The CHINESE version of the same bullet omits both: « USB、光纤、同轴支持DSD传输，同轴和光纤支持DOP64；». Three sources against one, and the one is a bullet copied from another model - `inputs` holds four keys and no AES, no I2S. Caught only by reading the rear panel and the menu against the marketing line.
_le_DoP_a_son_propre_plafond_PAR_PRISE_e: « USB DoP DoP256 » against « Optical / Coaxial DoP DoP64 » - the maker gives a DoP ceiling for each socket, separately from the native DSD figure of 22.5792 MHz on USB. And « native » appears nowhere in this manual's English text, unlike the 2022 model which says it outright, so `native_dsd` is absent here and present there. Same maker, consecutive years, and the field goes two ways.
